text.downloadExplanation: Downloads the latest matching measurement for every sensor for {{parameter}} at {{aggregation}}, from {{source}}. Covers all locations, regardless of the visible map area. Observation times vary by sensor; there is no date cutoff or historical series.
text.deviceDownloadExplanation: Downloads the device inventory for {{parameter}}, from {{source}}. Includes devices without measurements or coordinates, regardless of activity or the visible map area. Time resolution does not filter devices.
text.aqiDownloadExplanation: Downloads the latest AQI result for each matching location for {{product}}, from {{source}}, including unavailable results with their status. The visible map area does not limit this export. This is not a historical series; use Analytics for historical AQI export.
text.downloadEmpty: No records match these filters. No file was downloaded.
text.downloadFailed: The export could not be completed. No file was downloaded. Please try again.
